public.text: The definition requires DPI-H to be “publicly governed,” but the minimum attributes of public governance are not specified. This may lead countries to interpret public ownership, public operation, and public accountability as equivalent.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a concise definition covering public authority over policy, access conditions, change control, audit rights, service obligations, data portability, and supplier exit arrangements.
